items.text: Guard and scout health increased, making them tougher to kill.
Scout combat improvements: added hit reactions, recovery wobble, and damage smoke, affecting combat feedback.
Added offset map search circles and icon‑only compass guidance for missions, improving waypoint visibility.
Fixed tooltip position offset that varied with FPS, ensuring consistent tooltip placement.
Fixed settings dropdowns re‑opening after closing, preventing UI annoyance.
Recycle Bin now correctly swaps items instead of showing an erroneous "Container does not accept player items!" message.
Fixed train tunnel entrances, station orientations, and above‑ground ramp connections to prevent them spawning into voids or being blocked, improving map navigation.
Extended monument ladders, fixed water entry issues, and refined ladder movement contacts and performance for smoother and more reliable climbing.
Door controllers no longer become unpaired when a door is re‑skinned, preserving door functionality.
Thrown weapon skins now correctly apply while the projectile is in flight.
Catapult off‑map clipping bug fixed, preventing catapults from clipping through terrain.
Invisible building blocks bug fixed, ensuring placed blocks are visible to players.
Added CZ‑721 backstory, optional conversations, and mission plan records to the Extraction mission.
Refined mission interactions: hold‑E mission lock, 5‑second ledger reads, repair materials consumed after completion, expanded mission card UI, and safe‑pocket items preserved on load.
First loot item now appears early in the mission and hotbar outlines are removed.
Added loot reveal feature to Extraction missions.
Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, dodgeable charges, 55‑damage blasts, and mid‑fight strikes.
Raids cannot be started without a raid map; the game now blocks attempts lacking a map.
Added hotbar action progress bar and aligned third‑person reload animations.
Fixed third‑person attack alignment for more accurate hits.
Displayed reload progress bar next to the weapon in the shoulder camera.
Loot items now have explicit scrap values displayed, and pricing reflects item type, including furniture contents and blueprint weights.
Supplies shop prices increased and every item now has a value; loot above crafted gear is highlighted.
Safe pocket now counts toward carried weight and is shown beside looted items.
Main inventory size on the extraction map reduced by 50%.
Extracted loot is automatically banked in a stash; raiders start with loot at raid start.
Each enemy type, including monument guards, now grants its own specific reward.
Guard loot now scales by tier; heavy enemies no longer drop client objects on death.
Monuments are guarded by tiered forces, with weaker factions placed under scientists.
Added scout drones that patrol small monuments, emit light, can search, and have health; they raise alarms when spotting players.
Outpost added to the extraction map, with more monuments and a new 3 k procedural map scene for extraction raids.
Extraction balloons now show a timer on the map and close sequentially.
Outpost removed from the main raid map.
Players can no longer deploy structures while crafting.
Hub now has its own markers; arriving players no longer see a map or death screen.

2026-11-16.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

items.text: Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.
Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.
Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.
A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.
Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.

2026-11-15.summary:
### Missions & Interactions
- Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.

### Drones
- Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.

### Raiding
- Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.

### NPC & AI
- A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.

### Loot & UI
- Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.

2026-11-14.summary:
### Loot & Economy
- Loot now has value‑based pricing, furniture containers have their own specific contents, and blueprints count toward inventory weight.

### Combat & Enemies
- Each enemy type now drops its own unique reward, including monument guards.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Hotbar now shows an action progress bar, indicating how long actions like building or using items will take.
- Console window is now resizable and includes a blurred backdrop, making command input clearer and UI more flexible.
- Error overlay stacking now respects stack‑trace order, ensuring error messages are displayed correctly.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Fixed third-person attack alignment, ensuring attacks now line up correctly with target direction.
